name: Balance Clients TOP 10
description: Classement des 10 meilleurs clients avec répartition du CA

query.sql: SELECT c.nom as client, SUM(f.montant_ttc) as ca_total, COUNT(f.id) as nb_factures FROM clients c JOIN factures f ON f.client_id = c.id WHERE f.date_facture >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months' GROUP BY c.id, c.nom ORDER BY ca_total DESC LIMIT 10
